declarations.description:
`<loomi-table>` — a BladewindUI-inspired data table with manual slots, dynamic
rows, search, sorting, grouping, selection, checkboxes, pagination, empty states,
custom row templates and action icons.
declarations.name: LoomiTable

slots.description: Manual `<th>` cells, or a `<template>` for custom layout headings.
slots.name: header

slots.description: Optional `<template>` used when `layout="custom"` and `data` is set.
slots.name: row

events.name: loomi-selection-change
events.description: `detail: { ids, rows, selectedValue }` when selected rows change.

events.name: loomi-action-call
events.description: `detail: { name, row, action, click, resolvedClick }` for Bladewind-style click strings.

events.name: loomi-action
events.description: `detail: { name, row, action, click }` when an action icon is clicked.

events.name: loomi-row-click
events.description: `detail: { row, id }` when a row is clicked.

events.name: loomi-empty-action
events.description: `detail: { action }` when the empty-state button is clicked.
